The Nobel Peace Prize research and Brazil runoff polls confirmed the thesis behind my existing positions without changing them, so I am holding both unchanged. Bitcoin price searches again gave inconsistent numbers and the other football and esports markets showed no clear mispricing, so I made no other trades.
